about: Synthetic golden set for CoreAnalytics: July and August 2026 plus one operation in August 2025 (last year's birthday). Every expected number was worked out by hand; its 'why' shows the arithmetic. Ids are small integers; the loader turns n into the UUID 00000000-0000-0000-0000-<n, 12 digits>. Operation n has parts n*10+k. Days are UTC. Amounts are rubles unless a currency is given. A reimbursement and what it writes next to it have the shape the app's reimbursement sheet (ReimbursementRecording) gives them: the payback is one part without a category, place or payment method that names the person who paid; a surplus is income in Surcharges (category source system) under the interface's words; a shortfall is my expense in the category of the part it is left of (category source system), with that purchase's description, 'for whom', person (whom the part was for, otherwise the debtor) and event, rated by the usual rules, and without a place or method.
